description: This script sends a link to a process running LinkReceiver by locating its PID, reading a port number from a temporary file, and establishing a socket connection to send the link. It is specific to Linux and macOS platforms, and interacts with process and socket APIs.

methods.name: _Uncase
methods.description: Converts text to uppercase then lowercase, effectively normalizing case.

methods.name: _GetPids
methods.description: Retrieves process IDs for a given executable by inspecting /proc on Linux/macOS.

methods.name: _FindTemporaryFile
methods.description: Finds a temporary file with a specific prefix and suffix in the system temp directory.

methods.name: _ConnectWithRetry
methods.description: Attempts to connect a socket to a specified port with retries.

methods.name: SendLink
methods.description: Main function that sends a link to a process identified by its executable name.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and invokes SendLink.
